reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified 4C as a water supply fault, told the homeowner to check the supply tap first, and resolved the problem in one exchange when the closed isolation valve was found; it also sensibly advised isolating power before touching the inlet filter and closed with a correct, useful explanation of valve orientation. Conversation 2 ignored the 4C code entirely, ran through irrelevant door/child-lock/delay-start questions, then ignored the homeowner's volunteered clues about no water and recent plumbing work and escalated to an engineer for a nonexistent 'start control' fault, which is an incorrect diagnosis and an unjustified escalation.
